title: P.C.M.
description: Portable Cloning Machine. Including a Charger that can charge the P.C.M.
body:
## Portable Cloning Machine:

Adds a Portable Cloning Machine which can clone any item or block that can be inputed but after 1000 uses of it, it disables making it unable to clone anything meaning you have to charge it using the Battery Charger that can charge up to 3000 uses. 

It adds:
- Portable Cloning Machine (1000 uses/charge)
- Battery Charger for the Portable Cloning Machine (3000 charge)
- Command to set the PCM's Charge
- Recipes for both the PCM and Battery Charger

The PCM's Charge is the same across PCM's but not players meaning that the PCM's variable charge is not different across PCM's but it is instead a "player persistant" variable

<details>
<summary>How to use PCM</summary>

Click on the PCM then in the GUI insert a item into the left input slot and it will clone into the right slot, allowing you to take the item and clone it.

</details>


<details>
<summary>Modpack Use</summary>

_I allow this mod to be used in any modpack._

</details>
